d:
Experience the timeless pain of separation with the soulful song “Char Dinon Da Pyar O Rabba Lambi Judai” from the iconic film Hero. Beautifully sung by the legendary folk singer Reshma, this emotional track captures the deep feeling of love and longing.
Song: Lambi Judai
Artist: Reshma
Music director: Laxmikant Pyarelal
Lyricist: Anand Bakshi
Filmstar: Meenakshi Seshadri, Jackie Shroff, Shammi Kapoor, Sanjeev Kumar, Shakti Kapoor, Neeta Mehta, Bindu
Director: Subhash Ghai
